title: MarketRadar Unit-Test Summary Quality Rubric
source: Adapted from eval/rubric.json (lint) for the unit-test regression profile. Same scale and thresholds.

dimensions.name: Test Result Accuracy
dimensions.description: Does the summary correctly report whether the test suite passed or failed and accurately connect that claim to the recorded command result?

levels.1: Incorrectly reports test success or failure.
levels.2: Mentions the test outcome ambiguously or incompletely.
levels.3: Clearly and correctly reports test pass/fail.
levels.4: Correct outcome supported by the specific command, counts and exit status.

dimensions.name: Test and Failure Coverage
dimensions.description: Does the summary report the test files, test counts and every failing test from the recorded output, without omissions or invented results?

levels.2: Reports some counts or failures but omits significant ones.
levels.3: Reports file and test counts and all failures evidenced by the output.
levels.4: Complete, per-file reporting that ties the tests to the task under regression.

dimensions.name: Recommendation Quality
dimensions.description: Is the recommended next step appropriate, actionable, and proportionate to the recorded test findings?

levels.1: Recommends proceeding despite failing tests without acknowledging risk.
levels.2: Offers vague advice disconnected from specific findings.
levels.3: Recommends an appropriate next action consistent with the results.
levels.4: Provides clear, ordered, actionable next steps consistent with the evidence.
